description: A document model for creating and managing work breakdown structures with task hierarchy
name: Work Breakdown Structure

operations.description: Create a new work breakdown structure
operations.name: CREATE_WBS
operations.schema:
input CreateWbsInput {
  id: OID!
  title: String!
  description: String
  budget: Float
  timeline: String
  createdAt: DateTime!
}
operations.template: Create a new work breakdown structure

operations.name: UPDATE_WBS_INFO
operations.schema:
input UpdateWbsInfoInput {
  title: String
  description: String
  budget: Float
  timeline: String
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

operations.name: CREATE_TASK
operations.reducer:
const newTask = {
  id: action.input.id,
  parentTaskId: action.input.parentTaskId || null,
  code: action.input.code,
  title: action.input.title,
  summary: action.input.summary || null,
  description: action.input.description || null,
  status: action.input.status,
  priority: action.input.priority,
  progress: 0,
  estimatedHours: action.input.estimatedHours || null,
  actualHours: null,
  startDate: action.input.startDate || null,
  dueDate: action.input.dueDate || null,
  createdAt: action.input.createdAt,
  updatedAt: null
};

state.tasks.push(newTask);
state.updatedAt = action.input.createdAt;
operations.schema:
input CreateTaskInput {
  id: OID!
  parentTaskId: OID
  code: String!
  title: String!
  summary: String
  description: String
  status: TaskStatus!
  priority: TaskPriority!
  estimatedHours: Int
  startDate: DateTime
  dueDate: DateTime
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

errors.description: Task with the specified ID was not found
errors.name: TaskNotFoundError

operations.name: UPDATE_TASK
operations.schema:
input UpdateTaskInput {
  taskId: OID!
  code: String
  title: String
  summary: String
  description: String
  status: TaskStatus
  priority: TaskPriority
  progress: Int
  estimatedHours: Int
  actualHours: Int
  startDate: DateTime
  dueDate: DateTime
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

operations.description: Move task to different parent or make it a root task

errors.description: Task with the specified ID was not found
errors.name: TaskNotFoundError

errors.description: Parent task with the specified ID was not found
errors.name: ParentTaskNotFoundError

errors.description: Cannot make a task its own descendant
errors.name: CircularDependencyError

operations.name: MOVE_TASK

operations.description: Delete a task and all its subtasks

errors.description: Task with the specified ID was not found
errors.name: TaskNotFoundError

operations.name: DELETE_TASK

global.schema:
type WbsTask {
  id: OID!
  parentTaskId: OID
  code: String!
  title: String!
  summary: String
  description: String
  status: TaskStatus!
  priority: TaskPriority!
  progress: Int
  estimatedHours: Int
  actualHours: Int
  startDate: DateTime
  dueDate: DateTime
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime
}

type TeamMember {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  email: String
  role: String
  avatar: String
  isActive: Boolean!
  joinedAt: DateTime!
}

enum TaskStatus {
  SCOPING
  TODO
  IN_PROGRESS
  REVIEW
  DONE
  BLOCKED
  CANCELLED
}

enum TaskPriority {
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
  STRETCH
  CRITICAL
}

type WorkBreakdownStructureState {
  id: OID!
  title: String
  description: String
  budget: Float
  timeline: String
  tasks: [WbsTask!]!
  teamMembers: [TeamMember!]!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime
}
